title: Deposition envelope (nikodemus.deposition.v1) — the outer custody shape around a producer's signed package; the producer's native schema lives inside payload unchanged

version.description: the producer application's revision (a git sha or a version string; 'unknown' when it cannot say)

constitution_version.description: the producer's declared constitution / methodology version or hash

recorded_at.description: when the producer says the content was produced (a sealing or research time) — the producer's clock; Nikodemus records its own received_at beside it

payload_sha256.description: hex sha256 over the RFC 8785 canonical form of payload

payload.description: the producer's native signed payload, unchanged; null only for a legacy seal whose content the producer cannot reproduce

attachments.description: producer material NOT covered by the signature, labeled signed:false

method.description: open_case.seal.v1: Ed25519 over utf8(hex(sha256(jcs(payload)))); ethicalalt.export.v2: Ed25519 over jcs(payload)

trusted_key_id.description: sha256 over the raw 32-byte Ed25519 public key — a fingerprint the owner pins on the connector out of band; never a key
